evidence_boundary: Authored positive/near-miss criteria, not model execution. Independent observed outputs are recorded in the design audit report.

cases.prompt: Choose a readable role scale and line measure for a bilingual article; prove long headings, fallback fonts and narrow widths against representative content.
quality_assertions: Do not ban an approved font

cases.prompt: Develop an approved brand direction into a mark, palette and imagery system that survives a small avatar, monochrome invoice and packaging.
quality_assertions: Screen color is not press color

cases.prompt: Our shipped product has three divergent button libraries and inconsistent semantic tokens. Inventory consumers and propose a maintainable migration with compatibility and ownership.
The query and denominators are validated. Choose an honest chart encoding and scales for comparing hospital readmission rates, and show missing groups and uncertainty.
quality_assertions: No invented intervals or inflated axes

cases.prompt: Art-direct an approved 30-page report and its live presentation: reading order, captions, page rhythm and audience-distance legibility. File generation is handled elsewhere.

Give a read-only second opinion on supplied homepage captures against the approved purple identity. Locate visual and copy problems, what to keep and the smallest repairs; do not install an upstream launcher.
Walk this checkout prototype as an unfamiliar and returning customer. Inspect cancellation, pending, failure and recovery routes before implementation.
Review the rendered booking form for accessible names, keyboard/focus behavior, validation announcements and zoom reflow. Separate automated and manual coverage.
Critique existing transitions in a frequently used editor: interruptions, state continuity and reduced motion. We have source and video but no performance trace.
quality_assertions: Frequency is contextual, not universal duration
